metadata.case_name: TSANG WAI HUNG v. TRUSTFUL ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION COMPANY LTD AND OTHERS

plaintiff.education_level: received education in the Mainland up to Form 2 in secondary school

injuries.description: Injury by electric shock / electric current to right upper limb
source: Patient attended AED on 6 August 2012 for right upper limb injury by electric current whilst at work on day of attendance
Emergency admission for electric shock over right arm on 6 August 2012
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

injuries.description: Right shoulder massive rotator cuff tear (including supraspinatus, infraspinatus and subscapularis), long head biceps intrasubstance tear/subluxation and occult posterior glenoid fracture extending into the articular surface
source: right shoulder massive rotator cuff tear, including a supraspinatus, infraspinatus and subscapularis and occult position glenoid fracture extending into the articular surface

Operation record of PWH dated 25 April 2013: "Torn superior 2/3 of subscapularis tendon ... Long head biceps quite degenerative, with intra-substance tear of intra-articular part, & totally subluxed from the bicipital groove ... Complete full thickness tear of supraspinatus tendon with severe retraction of fibre ... Occult fracture noted in the posterior osseous glenoid extending into the articular surface."

Medical report prepared by Dr S H Yung of O&T PWH dated 24 December 2013: "Subsequent clinical and radiological (MRI & Ultrasound) confirmed massive rotator cuff tear of right shoulder and bicep tendon tear"
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: Psychiatric disorder - Major Depressive Disorder arising after the injury
source: The psychiatric diagnosis of Major Depressive Disorder
Medical report prepared by Dr Wong Ka Yee Lydia of the Department of Psychiatry of PWH dated 25 November 2014: "Diagnosed to suffered from depressive disorder"
Medical report prepared by Li Ching Anna of AED PWH dated 3 November 2014: "reported low mood and poor sleep after injury in 2012"

manifestations.description: blisters over right hand / right middle finger got blister
dizziness and blurred vision immediately after electric shock
decreased range of motion of right shoulder (abduction and flexion limited)
pain and weakness of right shoulder with limitation despite physiotherapy; residual pain and weakness post-operation
reduced shoulder power on right (supraspinatus/infraspinatus power around 4/5)
low mood, insomnia, poor appetite, suicidal thoughts, crying spells, low self-esteem and motivation

treatments_received: attendance at AED (Accident & Emergency Department) on 6 and 10 August 2012
psychiatric assessment and treatment (antidepressant and hypnotics)
treatments_future: psychiatric follow-up sessions (sick leave granted for attendance of psychiatric follow-ups)

losses.description: Permanent loss of right shoulder function due to massive rotator cuff tear, biceps tendon injury and occult glenoid fracture causing pain, weakness, reduced range of motion and muscle wasting
